activity.notes: Victor Emmanuel II was proclaimed the first King of Italy on 17 March 1861 and remained king until his death in 1878. ATLAS records only the Kingdom of Italy phase here; his preceding kingship of Sardinia is a distinct political context.

sources.title: Vittorio Emanuele II, re d'Italia — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani identifies Victor Emmanuel II as the first King of Italy from 1861 to 1878.
